notes: node --test --test-reporter=tap platform/pages/*.test.mjs, same 4-core container, Node v22.22.0. Before: wall 593.2s, 1162 tests, 1161 pass, 1 fail (custom-domain default-origin, from PR 8767's post). After: wall 417.7s, 1162/1162 pass. Per-test duration_ms before -> after: identical-build cache name 196,599 -> 103,176; worker change changes cache name 110,056 -> 26,734; no test payload published 102,301 -> 98,807 (first site() caller, pays the shared build); worker withdrawn (disableWorker, own build kept) 99,513 -> 105,308. Two fixture-dir buildSite calls (/compare/, /guides/) left as is (<1s). No assertion weakened; the identical-build test now also asserts distinct outDirs. After merging main (which was red), fixed in this PR: writing.mjs rebase() rewrites DEFAULT_BASE_URL links in posts to the build base (custom-domain.test.mjs; new test in writing.test.mjs); entities.mjs gains rho/lceil/rceil; changepoint-detector FAQ JSON-LD quotes match the page; platform/marketing/regen.mjs re-run (share card, sitemap, catalog). Final, merged tree: pages 1163/1163 in 422.8s; marketing 275/275; changepoint-detector 44/44; writing.test 9/9. Second merge of main (f56d696e1): PR 8767 and main's own fixes for all those failures had landed, so this branch took main's versions; final diff vs main is build.test.mjs, the history doc and this record. Final on merged tree: pages 1182/1182 in 412.7s; promptctl validate ok; check_md_links ok.

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: reading a 5,000-line test file, two 10-minute suite runs, write-up

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
CI minutes and the reviewer bots' own model calls
